title: router-contextd reader view (F1)
description: The answer to one router-context-query-v1. Filtered by the caller's trusted scope before counting, ranking, limiting and rendering. Hidden and nonexistent items read the same (not_found). Prompt renderers may drop the machine keys v, op, stream, alias_scope, kb_version (the host keeps alias_scope for follow-up queries); they must keep status, caveats, unknown, availability and coverage.

status.description: Anything but ok means the records are not a complete answer; unavailable is never 'nothing happened'.

as_of.description: producer capture time of the snapshot facts; null without a valid wall clock

origin.description: provenance of what the view returns; unknown = rows written before schema v3

coverage.description: partial/filtered: D04 findings only (findings_state insufficient_data / none_visible)

findings_state.description: D04 finding reads: why the list is what it is. no_rule_fired = every listed rule ran on enough samples and none fired (status ok, caveat no_finding_not_health_claim: not a health or safety claim); insufficient_data = source stale/absent or an entity in scope short of min_samples (limited); not_evaluated = no evaluation yet, or not live under require_live (unavailable); none_visible = role, grant or where filter limit the rows, no claim about the rest (limited, coverage filtered)

rule_coverage.description: D04: per rule, entities in scope evaluated on >= min_samples, short of samples, and fired; absent for filtered views

evaluated_at.description: D04: time of the finding evaluation the view describes

records.description: Projections of the kind's registry 'projection' (concise) or all fields (detail); private fields only for roles with private_fields; client entity ids rendered as aliases dN of alias_scope

alias_scope.description: binding of the dN aliases in this view; a query using them passes it back

stats_as_of.description: capture time of the statistics group when older than the file (stats_not_refreshed)

excluded_samples.description: samples in the window of another origin (or non-live with require_live), left out of the stats

retained_from.description: oldest sample the store still holds when the window reaches further back

compare.description: read_history before/after: per side since, until, samples, valid_samples, coverage_ratio, stats, excluded_samples, max_gap_s

delta_mean.description: after.mean - before.mean in the metric's unit; only with enough valid samples on both sides, one origin, a gauge metric

caveats.description: Codes that change the meaning of the answer, e.g. phy_rate_not_internet_speed, dns_configured_not_tested, one_target_not_all_services, security_feed_down_no_safety_claim, no_finding_not_health_claim, rule_samples_insufficient, filtered_view_no_claim, ack_is_not_execution, postcondition_unverified, not_effective_config, preview_not_valid, rule_not_active, not_delivered, user_reported_not_measured, proposal_not_confirmed, simulated_data, source_stale, no_wall_clock, observed_by_polling, counter_reset_split, content_not_approved, record_not_current, other_origin_excluded, non_live_excluded, origin_unknown, data_origin_changed, stats_not_refreshed, stats_freshness_unknown, retention_shorter_than_window, before_after_not_causal, compare_side_insufficient, counter_metric_no_delta

unknown.description: registry metrics the view would need but no producer supplies
